Separately and independently of this specific failure, the frozen contract's pinning clause requires a SPECIFIC pinned release (version string, wheel sha256, Julia version, SymbolicRegression.jl version, tree hash) established at Stage 0a BEFORE any measured table was read; Stage 0a recorded pysr_available: false and pysr_version: null, so NO PIN was ever established -- there is no 'pinned release' for this dispatch to install even if the Julia download had succeeded. Both facts independently require stage1_pysr_fits to be reported as failed_infrastructure for the PySR arm: (1) no pin exists to install against, and (2) a genuine fresh attempt at ANY version still fails on this host's Julia backend. Per the contract's own invalidation_rule, no unpinned PySR version was run or used for any claim; the arm is dropped and the primary engine (exhaustive_grammar) stands alone.
